critical_bugs.title: PHANTOM GAME: BKN @ BKN in latest-picks.json
critical_bugs.description: Game entry has home='BKN' and away='BKN' — same team on both sides. market_implied=0.0952 (odds +950) while model gives 61.3% probability. Edge=0.5176 causing it to rank #1 in value_bets as a $5 moneyline bet. This phantom propagates to Telegram bot picks and bankroll simulation.
critical_bugs.root_cause: nba-daily-odds.py get_todays_games() uses substring matching on teamName for both home and away using the same TEAM_MAP loop. If teamName='Nets' it can match against 'Brooklyn Nets' for BOTH home and away simultaneously. The V3/V2 fallback also uses next((f for f in TEAM_MAP if name in f), name) which is non-deterministic for partial matches.
critical_bugs.reproduction: normalize_team('San Antonio') -> 'SAN' (falls through to name.upper()[:3]). 'LA Clippers' -> 'LA ' (3-char truncation with trailing space).
critical_bugs.fix_required: Add assert game['home'] != game['away'] guard after game construction in nba-daily-odds.py and in the predict pipeline. Filter in betting_agent.load_inputs().
critical_bugs.fix_code:
# In betting_agent.py load_inputs(), after building candidates:
# candidates = [c for c in candidates if c['home'] != c['away']]
# In nba-daily-odds.py generate_odds_api_format():
# if home == away: continue  # skip phantom games
critical_bugs.impact: Current: BKN @ BKN bet of $5 at +950 in active bet slip. Bankroll at risk: $5. Telegram alert sent to @Nomos42 channel with phantom bet.

critical_bugs.title: ODDS SANITY: |model_prob - market_implied| > 0.50 not filtered
critical_bugs.description: No filter exists for extreme model/market divergence. BKN @ BKN game: model=0.6128, market_implied=0.0952, gap=0.5176. This is not alpha — it is a data error. The MIN_EV_THRESHOLD=0.10 and MIN_EDGE_THRESHOLD=0.05 filters do NOT catch this because they allow large edges.
critical_bugs.root_cause: betting_agent.py build_candidates() has no max-divergence cap. The only guards are MIN_ODDS=1.30, MAX_ODDS=8.0, MIN_EV=0.10. A gap >0.50 signals either a phantom game or corrupted odds data, not a genuine edge.

critical_bugs.title: CALIBRATION CATASTROPHE: ECE=0.2758, 60-70% bucket actual=16.7%
critical_bugs.file: nomos-political-alpha/calibration/isotonic_calibrator.py (exists but not wired into NBA pipeline)
critical_bugs.description: An IsotonicPostCalibrator class exists in nomos-political-alpha/calibration/ but is NOT used in the NBA prediction pipeline. The hf-space/features/engine.py (v3.0-43cat) has no Platt scaling or isotonic calibration. The 60-70% model confidence bucket yielding only 16.7% actual wins means the model is severely overconfident — systematic upward bias.
critical_bugs.root_cause: 1) ENGINE_VERSION='v3.0-43cat' in hf-space/features/engine.py but CLAUDE.md declares v3.1-46cat — version mismatch suggests calibration upgrade was planned but not deployed. 2) Calibration breakpoints JSON does not exist at data/calibration/isotonic_breakpoints.json. 3) isotonic_calibrator.py only has IsotonicPostCalibrator.calibrate() — no fit_and_export() integration in training loop.

ece_analysis.diagnosis: Model sees strong features (home court, rest, ratings) but lacks historical win-rate calibration. Tree ensembles trained on imbalanced or small samples notoriously overpredict in 60-70% range.
ece_analysis.fix_approach: Platt scaling (sigmoid fit on holdout) is faster to implement than isotonic for small calibration sets. Isotonic is better for large sets (>100 games per bucket).

critical_bugs.fix_required: 1) Wire isotonic_calibrator.py into HF Space training loop after GA selection. 2) Export breakpoints to data/calibration/isotonic_breakpoints.json. 3) Apply calibration in predict_today.py before writing latest-picks.json.
critical_bugs.priority: P1 — affects every bet sizing decision (Kelly uses model_prob directly)
critical_bugs.status: UNFIXED — calibration infrastructure exists in political alpha but not wired into NBA
